description: A theme's master: its settings and the artwork every slide shows.

markdownpoint.description: The format version, its major and minor in quotes: "1.0". MarkdownPoint 1.x opens any version 1.x file. A newer major needs a newer MarkdownPoint.

id.description: The theme's identity, a lowercase UUID. It stays the same when the theme is renamed, installed under another key, or shared, and tells apart two themes of the same key.

name.description: The theme's name, on one line. Left out, it's the theme's key with spaces for its hyphens and a capital first letter.

category.description: The category the theme is listed under: basic, business, education, community, or personal. A category draws nothing, so another word only warns, and the theme is listed as uncategorized.

size.description: The slide size. Left out, it's 1920 × 1080.

unit-scale.description: How many meters one canvas unit stands for, as 3ds Max's System Unit Scale. At 0.001, a canvas unit is a millimeter, and one meter of a model's GLB spans 1000 canvas units. Left out, it's 0.001.

fonts.description: The font family for each font role.

display.description: The family for headings and large type.

font-files.description: The theme's embedded fonts, by family name: a list of .eot files, one per face, for each family a font role uses. A generic family has none.

brand.description: The brand's named colors, for use in schemes.

colors.description: The brand's colors, by name, as hex colors.

additionalProperties.description: One color scheme: a color for each of its six roles, and for any further role it names. Every theme has light and dark, and can add more. Each role's color is a hex color or a brand color written `{brand.name}`.

appearance.description: Whether the scheme is light or dark. Schemes named light and dark don't state it.

background.description: The slide's base color, under everything else.

accent.description: The color for emphasis: a shape's default fill, highlighted text, and a chart's first series.

stroke.description: The color of a table's grid, and of any outline or line set to it.

schemes.description: The theme's color schemes, by name. Every theme has light and dark.

additionalProperties.description: One text style. Keys left out default to inset-top and inset-bottom 0, paragraph-spacing half the font size, and list-indent 1.25 times it. Bullets are disc, circle at the second level, and square below it.

font-family.description: The font role the text uses: display, body, or mono. The theme sets a font family for each role.

font-weight.description: The font weight: 300 light, 400 regular, 500 medium, 600 semibold, 700 bold or 900 black.

color.description: The color: a color role or a hex color.

line-height.description: The distance between lines, as a multiple of the font size.

case.description: The letter case shown, while the text stays as typed. `title` capitalizes the first letter of each word.

inset-top.description: The space between the text box's top and its first line.

inset-bottom.description: The space between the text box's last line and its bottom.

list-indent.description: How far each list level indents.

bullet-style.description: The bullet at a list's first level.

sub-bullet-style.description: The bullet at the second list level. The third level and deeper are squares.

marks.description: How bold, italic, highlighted, struck-through, and code text look in this style.

font-family.description: The font role the text uses: display, body, or mono. The theme sets a font family for each role.

color.description: The color: a color role or a hex color.

case.description: The letter case shown, while the text stays as typed. `title` capitalizes the first letter of each word.

bold.description: How bold text looks. Bold is weight 700, or its text's weight where that's heavier. It holds over any mark or own weight inside it, so bold takes no font-weight. Left out, it's the text's font.

highlight.description: How highlighted text looks: colored, on no background. By default it's the accent color at weight 600, never lighter than the text around it.

code.description: How code looks. Left out, it's the mono font at 0.92 times the text's size.

text-styles.description: The theme's text styles, by name. No name is built in, and none can't be one.

items.description: One ruler guide. It has x or y, not both.

id.description: The guide's id, unique among the master's guides.

x.description: A vertical guide's position across: any number of canvas units, or a percentage of the slide from 0% to 100%, such as "50%".

y.description: A horizontal guide's position down: any number of canvas units, or a percentage of the slide from 0% to 100%, such as "50%".

name.description: The guide's name, on one line.

locked.description: Whether the guide is locked against dragging.

guides.description: Ruler guides on every slide. A single malformed guide makes MarkdownPoint refuse the whole master.

grid.description: The layout grid: columns and a baseline grid.

gutter.description: The space between columns. Left out, 0.

margin.description: The margin on the left and on the right. Left out, 0.

start.description: Where the first baseline is, from the slide's top.

step-duration.description: The default length of a fade or move in a newly added step. Left out, it's 0.5.

layout-order.description: The order the layouts appear in the layout chooser, by key, each once.

text-path.description: SVG path data in frame units

anyOf.description: a normalized path inside the theme’s folder, not hidden and not manifest.json, previews, or example

mask.description: SVG path data in frame units

image-style.description: nonempty text without NUL characters, or none

target-joint.description: the name of one of the model’s joints

objects.description: The master's objects, back to front. Every slide shows them behind its own. The camera and the World are among them, at their defaults when the file leaves them out.

text.description: The words of the master's own text, table, chart, and shape objects, by object id.

save.description: A save stamp, written by the last save before editing passes to another person. It tells this file apart from an older copy.

additionalProperties.description: one line with one space between words, none at the start or end, and no "-->"
